content:
Welcome to NeoCab, the ultimate e-cabinet designed for students of Kharkiv Polytechnic Institute!

NeoCab is a digital platform developed by a passionate student developer with a mission to provide a seamless and user-friendly experience for KhPI students. As a student of KhPI myself, I understand the importance of having easy access to academic information and resources, which is why I created NeoCab.

Our platform offers a wide range of features to enhance your academic journey. You can view attendances, record book, ratings, schedules, syllabuses, search for other students, and access frequently asked questions for additional help.

One of the standout features of NeoCab is its integration with Microsoft Office 365. This integration allows for seamless synchronization login information of your profile, making it easier for you to access your account and stay up-to-date with your academic progress.

At NeoCab, we are committed to continuous improvement and are always striving to provide the best possible experience for our users. We welcome your feedback and suggestions, so please feel free to reach out to us with any comments or concerns using the telegram bot @StudCabinet_Bot.

We take user privacy and security seriously. Our Privacy Policy designed to ensure that all users understand their rights and responsibilities when using NeoCab. By using our platform, users agree to adhere to these terms.

Thank you for choosing NeoCab as your go-to e-cabinet for all things academic at KhPI!
